== Build notes ==
Comparison requested by Bill for Story 173. This sandbox uses the same four published 60-card decks and calculation logic as the local website gallery. Card identities and quantities were checked against each record's original GEMP download. Outside-deck systems and defensive shields are separate. The native wiki component runs inside the article using a page-scoped loader and isolated styles. Builder edits are temporary local drafts; the card finder covers same-side cards in these four lists. No article deck lists were changed.
